title: Poundage
summary: POUND'AGE, noun [from pound.] A sum deducted from a pound, or a certain sum paid for each pound. 1. In England, a subsidy of 12d. in the pound, granted to the crown on all goods exported or imported,

inlines.v: POUND'AGE, noun [from pound.] A sum deducted from a pound, or a certain sum paid for each pound. 1. In England, a subsidy of 12d. in the pound, granted to the crown on all goods exported or imported, and if by aliens, more.
